payload.summary: RESOLVED. parseNarration now matches by label: the reply is a JSON array of {n, text} and an entry lands on the event whose number it names, or on nothing. Unknown labels, repeated labels (first wins) and unlabelled entries are dropped rather than guessed at — dropping costs the engine's own sentence, guessing costs a fact told twice. Verified by a LIVE Poe drive (seed 42, 3 players, 36 calls / 36236 tokens): 34 model-voiced scenery lines and ZERO engine fallbacks, where the same drive before the fix showed 'The candlestick was discovered in the Dining Room.' followed by the engine's 'Candlestick is moved to the Dining Room.' The real model honours the labelled shape. SECOND SYMPTOM CURED, not originally attributed: the false '(the game master is not answering)' notice fired once in that healthy pre-fix game, because a mis-slotted reply left a slot null, which read as a vendor failure. BEFORE 1 occurrence, AFTER 0. Suite 381/0, tsc clean.
